en: Speak with Ironus, $n. He'll be the one training you in the way of the weaponsmith.
%s raises an undead servant back to life!

<Illaya smiles warmly at you.> 

I am glad you returned to speak with me, child of the winds. I knew it the first moment you walked into my presence, that you were strong in the skysight. Even for a Shaman, you show particular aptitude in our gift.

Come, let us speak about the mandate of the Windshapers, the nature of our struggles on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
Hey Jangdor - can you teach me how to make a Wild Leather Vest again?

Ye have my approval $n, ye can forge blades better than any I've trained in years. If ye want to make a real weapon though, ye need to talk with Myolor Sunderfury. That Dwarf will set ya on the right path.
The Alliance Flag has returned to its base!
Largely, yes. The thing we all have in common is that we have nowhere else to go and that we prefer thieving over enslaving ourselves to some insane cult.
Let's try planting it in some of my special, prepared soil...

We, the Zandalarian trolls, traveled here from distant islands, for we cannot ignore the threat that now faces our world.$B$BThe leader of our expedition, Molthor, brought us to the Yojamba Isle, along the northern coasts of Stranglethorn, and even now recruits brave heroes to venture into the ancient troll city... Zul'Gurub.
$C - I will consume your light!
The Cathedral of Light is the center of all the healing practices of Stormwind. There you can find Shaina Fuller to help you learn this craft.
May this evil aura be banished from this artifact!
Welcome to my shop, $c. What is it the Goodstitch brothers can do for you?
You will find Pyall Silentstride inside the great tent in the northwest corner of the village.  He can teach you what you crave.
I've got too much to do and not enough time to do it in, $r! Please, get out of my way.
Follow me, friends. To Stormwind Keep!
I've got to quit smoking! Give me a minute to catch my breath.
Strange.  Very strange...
The Scourge are defeated!  Darrowshire is saved!
Oh yeah, I heard about that.
What brings a tauren to the Plaguelands?
When the shaking stopped, his true motives were revealed. We were trapped, and he was slowly draining our powers.
Reginald, you know that I cannot let you pass.
Prizes!  Get your prizes right here!  Get over here and turn in your Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets for valuable prizes!

It is good to see others who fight the Scourge in Stratholme, for it is here they are strongest.$B$BGreetings.  I am Aurius.  I was once a paladin of the Silver Hand, but like others whose faith wavered... I fell from grace.  The Scourge seduced me and nearly transformed me into a death knight!$B$BFinally sensing my peril, I fled to this chapel.  It is a sacred place, where the first paladin, Uther the Lightbringer, was ordained into the order of the Silver Hand.
Your pet is wonderful, Gerard, but she needs a collar with a bell I think.
Hooray, $n!
Thank you for the spores, $n.  They are now prepared for transport.
May Cenarius watch over you, $g brother : sister;.$B$BI am Tajarri, and I am a sworn protector of this shrine.  It is my honor to serve Keeper Remulos as a warden of this sacred land.
Ragnaros will reign supreme!
As if I had all eternity.
Well... you almost impressed me. I suppose I could spare the time for a few lessons...
Know that wherever you might find them in the world, they are protecting something of importance, as they were entrusted to do so long ago.
More troggs! Ward them off as I prepare the explosives!
Oh, it's just terribly, terribly, awful! You will just DIE when you see it, Vivian.
$n KILL! $G He:She; kill you now! RUN! RUN!
Will you help?
%s begins to grow!
This place is safe for the Defias to take over! Get the others.

If you need help surviving in the woods, you had best not stray far from the city walls.  However if you do plan to stray, then you had better have a talk with Malygen in the Cenarion Enclave so that you might learn to set a proper campfire.
$n! THIS AREA IS OFF LIMITS!
How could you love me, Annalise? Look at me. I am not the man you once knew.
No, Longears isn't my real name.  And I'm not going to tell you what it is, so don't ask.
Hehehe! Things go boom!
WOOT!

All of a sudden you're a 'Defender of the Alliance' are you?! Well, I suppose you'll be wanting to head to the Champions' Hall now. It's over in Old Town, but they won't let you in unless you're an officer, so you might just have to settle for talking to Officer Areyn outside. Move along now.
Ah, the protective layer is nearly gone. Do you hear that, heroes? That... That is the sound of inevitability. Of your hopes and dreams being crushed under the weight of my being.
This is the answer to the first question of the first chain.
On guard, friend. The lady dragon will not give in without a fight.

I might be the only living shen'dorei left amongst our people who had more than a handful of words with him.

I served him as the captain of his Empyrean Blades for nearly nine centuries, right up until... he left us.

Even still, I can't rightly claim that I "knew" him. He was ever a reserved and solitary man. He spent most of his time alone or in communion with the spirits in the spires high above the Shrine of the Four Winds... the place that the cult now calls the 'Shrine of Akir'.
I'm just getting warmed up!

Where to begin? Our home is failing. The wards have fallen and the three provinces have begun to drift apart. There was a time not long ago when the spires of Shen'dramar were visible from the western watchtower. No longer. Day by day the wind pylons that anchor our home to this plane weaken...
